summary: Return only the local authority digest to the recent-inbound replication guard

replay.detail: No replay or projection behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, migrations or persisted cache changes.

rules.detail: The same replication_snapshot still seals, judges and computes the digest; comparison, push-on-error and scheduling stay.

compatibility.detail: Additive default-false authority_only body flag, omitted from ordinary requests and ignored by old daemons. New worker extracts digest from either full or compact local response; old workers get unchanged full summaries. Only typed Backend::authority_digest consumes compact responses; peer exchanges never request them.

downtime.detail: Normal rollout; no new service, collector or writer capacity.

manual.detail: Removes unnecessary full-summary assembly and clone work from guard calls, whose existing full store path was 16.21% of export route wall in one 293 s sample; the removable fraction and CPU saving are UNKNOWN. Shared snapshot work remains. Private controls are UNRUN; hosted work controls and separate finite post-install Ops acceptance remain required.

recovery.detail: Snapshot/read/decode/digest errors leave a push requested. No stale digest cache, retry waiver or new recovery procedure.
